precedents.explanation: Same trigger (number of insurer changes). NC-05 is more than 2 changes in 10 years; DR-013 is more than 3 in 2 years, a stricter definition of frequent switching that affects fewer people. The underlying problem, judging risk by shopping behaviour, is the same.
Pending Maplewood Mutual rule declines coverage lapses over 90 days. Both use insurance history, but a lapse is a gap in coverage while switching is continuous coverage with different insurers.
Pending Ridgeline Insurance Co. rule declines Facility Association insureds moving to the voluntary market. Both rely on insurance history rather than driving record, with different triggers.
